answer: The values concern different asset populations. Approximately 2.5 tCO2e/tCS is the average intensity attributed to assets that had been disposed, whereas 1.79 tCO2e/tCS is the 2025 adjusted group Scope 1 and 2 steel-and-mining intensity for the current/reporting-year portfolio. The scope distinction resolves the apparent difference; the figures alone do not establish why disposed assets were more intensive or prove that disposal caused the current intensity.

scope_boundary.disposed_assets: assets disposed since the historical comparison baseline
scope_boundary.current_group: adjusted to 2025 portfolio, Scope 1 and 2, steel and mining
